definitions.gloss: during that time; meanwhile; in the meantime
definitions.explanation: refers to the period of time while something else is happening

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}している→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。その{間|あいだ}、⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I'm on the phone. Wait for me in the meantime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cooking will take 30 minutes. Let's clean in the meantime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧にいた。その{間|あいだ}、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}いだ→引き継ぐ：12458_hikitsugu⟧。
examples.english: He was overseas. During that time, I took over his work.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
- その{間|あいだ}: the everyday reading
- その{間|かん}: formal and written, common in news (その{間|かん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧, the circumstances during that period)

USAGE:
- その{間|あいだ}、〜: the action or state fills the whole period (その{間|あいだ}、ずっと⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧, I waited the whole time)
- その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、〜: something happens at some point within the period (その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧をする, clean in the meantime)

WATCH OUT:
Use ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ with one-time actions done within the period. その{間|あいだ}⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧をした suggests cleaning the entire time.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦その{前|まえ}→その前：08502_sonomae⟧: before that
- ⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧: after that
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧: meanwhile; on the other hand (contrast between two situations)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until then
